The main takeaway from our work is that
loose rock and wire-bound rock structures increase local soil moisture and may help improve plant cover and soil stability in the semiarid southwestern US.
loose and wire bound rock dams are effective for increasing soil moisture in the channel bank and are a low cost, low tech, low risk alternative to more costly engineered structures.
